full.description: This is a composite clinical and microscopic image of the skin. The clinical photograph on the left shows a raised nodular lesion with prominent arborizing telangiectasias. The histological sections reveal the dermis invaded by irregular masses of basaloid cells with a characteristic peripheral palisading appearance, often separated from the stroma by a retraction artifact. These findings are diagnostic of nodular basal cell carcinoma.

random.description: The image shows a combination of clinical dermoscopy and histopathological micrographs of a skin lesion. The dermoscopic view reveals a well-circumscribed pink-red nodule with prominent arborizing telangiectasia. The histological sections display characteristic basaloid tumor islands with peripheral palisading and surrounding stromal retraction artifacts within the dermis. These findings are diagnostic of a nodular basal cell carcinoma.
